import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long inf = 2000000007L;
    static final int maxn = 1000004;
    static final int maxm = 204;
    static final int base = 1000000;

    static long n, ans;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] sum = new long[7];
    static long cnt1, cnt2;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
            for (Long x : val[i]) {
                sum[i] += x;
            }
        }
        cnt2 = -1;
        ans = 0;
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static long down(long x) {
        long res = ((x % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;
        return res;
    }

    static void dfs1(int dep, int num) {
        val[dep].add(down(cnt1 - num));
        cnt1++;
        if (dep == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            dfs1(dep + 1, num * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int dep, long num) {
        if (num > n) return;
        if (num * base + 999999 <= n && num * base * 10 > n) {
            for (int i = 0, l = 1; i < 7; i++, l *= 10) {
                long tmp = down(cnt2 - num * l + 1);
                int p = lowerBound(val[i], mod1 - tmp);
                long size = val[i].size();
                long sumVal = sum[i];
                long pLong = p;
                long sizeLong = size;
                long ansIncrement = (tmp * sizeLong + sumVal - mod2 * (sizeLong - pLong)) % mod2;
                ans = (ans + ansIncrement) % mod2;
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
        } else {
            cnt2++;
            ans = (ans + down(cnt2 - num)) % mod2;
            for (int i = (dep == 0) ? 1 : 0; i < 10; i++) {
                dfs2(dep + 1, num * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long target) {
        int left = 0, right = list.size();
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                right = mid;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return left;
    }
}
